tools.name: search_trends
tools.description: Search Jump on the Trend's live AI video trends and templates by name, meme, song, scene or topic (e.g. 'locker room', 'dog bartender', 'christmas', 'couple dance'). Optional filters: category and who's in it. Returns each trend's name, what happens in it, who can star, length, price and page link.

tools.name: get_trend
tools.description: Everything about one trend: what it is and where it came from, the original clip, the sound, who can star, the versions and prices, photo tips, ideas for who to cast, common questions, and the page link where the person adds their photo for a free preview.

tools.name: top_trends
tools.description: The trends doing best on Jump on the Trend right now, best first, with what's hot, rising and new this week.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The categories trends are filed under (pets, dance, couples, memes, seasons in season...) with how many trends each has.

tools.name: how_it_works
tools.description: How making a video works on Jump on the Trend, what's free, and today's prices.

tools.name: suggest_trend
tools.description: Send the team a TikTok, Instagram or YouTube link to a trend that isn't on Jump on the Trend yet. It is reviewed by hand; nothing is promised. Only use it when the person wants a trend that search_trends didn't find.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Jump on the Trend's AI video trends. Returns ids to pass to fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one trend's full page text by the id search returned.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
